title: Movie Theater Franchise Opportunity
name: PictureTime, 7 Franchisees, Est'd in 2023, New Delhi HQ
description: We are India's first patented portable E-cinema standard theatre. PictureTime is a scalable cinema chain bringing modern multiplex experiences to Tier-3 and smaller cities across India. Focused on Tier-3 and below markets, currently operating 7 profitable theatres built over the last 3 years. Business aims to scale to 100 theatres in 3 years using a POCO (partner owned, company operated) model, where local investors own assets and the company operate the cinemas. Revenue is primarily from ticket sales, food and beverage, and cinema advertising. The company is seeking partners and investors nationwide and is open to performance-linked fee structures with platforms that help source and close such partnerships. We provide theater setups at a much lower cost, with prices between INR 65 lakh and INR 85 lakh, while other brands typically charge anywhere from INR 5 crore to INR 15 crore. We also provide SOPs & training, operating procedures, on-site installation and operator training for consistent rollout, cloud-based ERP business management for inventory, revenue, expenses and reporting visibility, white-label mobile ticketing with online booking, seat selection and payments. We are recognised by. - MIB Recognition (Ministry of Information and Broadcasting) - MSME (Eligibility under Priority Sector Lending (PSL) norms, improving access to Institutional finance and structured funding).
